steps.text: In the Live data console, open the "Devices" tab. A device is the box plugged into a member's meter (P1 port) or inverter: it sends a reading every quarter-hour.
steps.title: Open the Devices tab

steps.text: Give the device a name you will recognise.
steps.title: Name the device

steps.text: Open the list of the community's meters.
steps.title: Pick the meter

steps.text: Choose the meter the device is connected to. A meter that already has a device is greyed out.
steps.title: Pick the meter

steps.text: Click "Create". Only tick "pure injection" for a site that consumes nothing: ticked by mistake, it would understate the community's production without any visible error.
steps.title: Create the device

steps.text: The device is created and its enrolment code shows immediately, as text and as a QR code. Type it (or scan it) into the device. It is shown only once, works only once and expires after 72 hours; if it is lost, issue a new one from the list — the old one then stops working.
steps.title: The enrolment code

steps.text: Close the window when you are done.
steps.title: Close

steps.text: Until the device has used its code, it is "awaiting enrolment" and "never seen". The box below says what to check: is the device powered and connected to the network?
steps.title: Awaiting enrolment
